note: What the launcher knows about the game's files. archives: RSA public keys of the game's archive headers (Data0-3.bhd, DLC.bhd), as published by the modding community (UXM). dcx_writer: the layouts the launcher writes, each loaded in game (docs/decisions). dflt_fallback: file types the game has loaded as DFLT in place of KRAK, written so only when the game's Oodle library is not there. mod_folders: the top-level folders of a package that me3 serves game files from. ignored_dlls: DLLs a mod download may carry that are not mods (mod loaders and runtimes).
